search_text: published ZDI-20-963 ZDI-CAN-8564 Delta Industrial Automation TPEditor TPE File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Read Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-08-10 CVE-2020-16219 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-16219 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Delta Industrial Automation'] ['TPEditor'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Industrial Automation TPEditor. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of TPE files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. As attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Delta Industrial Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Delta Industrial Automation TPEditor TPE File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Read Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Industrial Automation TPEditor. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of TPE files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. As attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
